#### 1. severe dermatitis-multiple allergies-metabolic wasting syndrome  —  Tier 1 — Definitive / Highly Plausible  (fitness 0.731)
**Link type:** shared causal gene (HGNC:3048)

**Proposed mechanism:** DSG1 (HGNC:3048) —DISRUPTS→ Abnormal keratinocyte adhesion (HP:0030172); Abnormal keratinocyte adhesion (HP:0030172) —LEADS_TO→ Palmoplantar keratoderma (HP:0000970); Abnormal keratinocyte adhesion (HP:0030172) —LEADS_TO→ Dermatitis (HP:0000967); Abnormal keratinocyte adhesion (HP:0030172) —LEADS_TO→ Allergic reaction (HP:0011766). Loss-of-function mutations in DSG1 disrupt keratinocyte adhesion, leading to the distinct but overlapping phenotypes of palmoplantar keratoderma and severe dermatitis with multiple allergies.
